hotspots.title: Triangulated Diagonal Strut & TIG Weld
hotspots.desc: Heavy-duty cantilever steel bracket bolted and precision-welded directly to the tabletop underframe to eliminate sag and side-to-side wobble under 130kg+ loads.

hotspots.title: Dual-Pillar High-Tensile Column
hotspots.desc: Dual upright architectural rectangular columns fabricated from 2.0mm thick cold-rolled aerospace steel, finished with electro-statically applied satin white powder coating.

hotspots.title: Precision Ground Stabilizer & Glides
hotspots.desc: Extended heavy-gauge rectangular base beam fitted with micro-adjustable anti-vibration leveling feet that adapt seamlessly to uneven tile or hardwood floors.

specs.Frame Material: Heavy-Gauge Cold Rolled Carbon Steel (2.0mm thickness)
specs.Tabletop Material: High-Density FSC-Certified Engineered Core with Anti-Scratch Melamine
specs.Surface Finish: Electrostatically Baked 80µm Matte White Powder Coat
specs.Certification: BIFMA X5.5 Commercial Grade & RoHS Compliant

features.title: Zero-Wobble Dual-Pillar Steel Frame
features.description: Constructed from industrial-strength structural steel with dual vertical uprights and triangular truss brackets for rock-solid stability during typing and intensive work.

features.title: Pure Architectural Matte White
features.description: Finished with an anti-reflective, fingerprint-repellent matte powder coat that preserves the clean, pristine Scandinavian aesthetic over years of daily use.

features.title: 130 kg True Load Bearing
features.description: Safely supports multiple ultra-wide monitors, studio audio monitors, heavy desktop towers, and desk-clamp accessories with zero deflection.

features.title: Micro-Adjustable Leveling System
features.description: Threaded precision glides underneath each base foot compensate for uneven floors while safeguarding hardwood, marble, or tile from scratches.

features.title: 12-Minute Effortless Assembly
features.description: Features pre-aligned threaded inserts, magnetized hex key, and custom precision bolts for a seamless one-person setup experience.

features.title: 100-Night In-Home Trial
features.description: Experience the Moon Venus Desk in your own workspace. If you don't fall in love, we will pick it up and refund 100% of your money.
